changes.name: BackpackExpansionSystem
changes.source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local COST = 10

local function getEssence(player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if leaderstats then
		local value = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Essence")
		if value and (value:IsA("IntValue") or value:IsA("NumberValue")) then
			return value
		end
	end

	local value = player:FindFirstChild("Essence")
	if value and (value:IsA("IntValue") or value:IsA("NumberValue")) then
		return value
	end

	return nil
end

local room = workspace:FindFirstChild("BackpackExpansionRoom")
if room then room:Destroy() end

room = Instance.new("Model")
room.Name = "BackpackExpansionRoom"
room.Parent = workspace

local function part(name, size, position, color, material, transparency)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	p.Size = size
	p.Position = position
	p.Anchored = true
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = material or Enum.Material.WoodPlanks
	p.Transparency = transparency or 0
	p.Parent = room
	return p
end

-- Temporary self-contained expansion room high above the map.
local center = Vector3.new(0, 220, 0)
part("Floor", Vector3.new(38, 1, 32), center, Color3.fromRGB(75, 58, 45), Enum.Material.WoodPlanks)
part("BackWall", Vector3.new(38, 16, 1), center + Vector3.new(0, 8, -16), Color3.fromRGB(53, 45, 42), Enum.Material.Slate)
part("LeftWall", Vector3.new(1, 16, 32), center + Vector3.new(-19, 8, 0), Color3.fromRGB(53, 45, 42), Enum.Material.Slate)
part("RightWall", Vector3.new(1, 16, 32), center + Vector3.new(19, 8, 0), Color3.fromRGB(53, 45, 42), Enum.Material.Slate)

local gate = part("SealedExpansion", Vector3.new(14, 14, 2), center + Vector3.new(0, 7, 15), Color3.fromRGB(43, 35, 33), Enum.Material.WoodPlanks)

local glow = part("ExpansionGlow", Vector3.new(10, 9, 0.4), center + Vector3.new(0, 7, 13.9), Color3.fromRGB(105, 70, 180), Enum.Material.Neon, 0.35)
glow.CanCollide = false

local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.Name = "ExpansionPrompt"
prompt.ActionText = "Expand Backpack - 10 Essence"
prompt.ObjectText = "Sealed Room"
prompt.HoldDuration = 1
prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 12
prompt.Parent = gate

local expanded = false

local function openExpansion()
	expanded = true
	gate.CanCollide = false
	gate.Transparency = 0.8
	glow.Transparency = 1
	prompt.Enabled = false

	part("NewFloor", Vector3.new(30, 1, 26), center + Vector3.new(0, 0, 29), Color3.fromRGB(87, 66, 48), Enum.Material.WoodPlanks)
	part("NewBackWall", Vector3.new(30, 16, 1), center + Vector3.new(0, 8, 42), Color3.fromRGB(47, 42, 45), Enum.Material.Slate)
	part("NewLeftWall", Vector3.new(1, 16, 26), center + Vector3.new(-15, 8, 29), Color3.fromRGB(47, 42, 45), Enum.Material.Slate)
	part("NewRightWall", Vector3.new(1, 16, 26), center + Vector3.new(15, 8, 29), Color3.fromRGB(47, 42, 45), Enum.Material.Slate)

	local core = part("ExpansionCore", Vector3.new(4, 4, 4), center + Vector3.new(0, 3, 32), Color3.fromRGB(125, 80, 255), Enum.Material.Neon)
	core.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball

	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Brightness = 2
	light.Range = 18
	light.Parent = core
end

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
	if expanded then return end

	local essence = getEssence(player)
	if not essence then
		warn("BackpackExpansionSystem: Could not find Essence for " .. player.Name)
		return
	end

	if essence.Value < COST then
		return
	end

	essence.Value -= COST
	openExpansion()
end)

print("Backpack Expansion #1 ready")
